name: normalize_document
description: Canonical repair for an open session document: runs the same allowlist normalizer CLI normalize calls (verified tag renames, whitelisted default infills, schema-sequence sorts) over the live package, then refreshes the session view and proves the result with a read-only validation verdict. Output bytes match CLI normalize on the same input. When the package is still invalid afterwards, the session is restored untouched and the call fails with E_VALIDATION plus a fix-and-retry remedy (same contract as CLI normalize writing nothing on failure). After the normalizer it repairs known validator error kinds one rule at a time; a rule that adds a validator error or changes the visible text is dropped and listed in rolledBack. Returns {ok:true,sessionId,revision,dirty,normalized,remaining,rolledBack,validation:{valid:true,...}} where normalized lists every rewrite once and remaining counts the validator errors left (-1 when the validator did not run), plus the standard redoCleared signal when a redo chain is dropped. Example {"sessionId":"sess_abc"} -> {"ok":true,"normalized":[...]}. Save after to persist.
